items.title: Why Robinhood Stock Is Jumping When Bitcoin, Other Crypto Plays Are Falling
items.summary: Robinhood  Markets stock has often moved with the price of Bitcoin but not today.  Shares of the mobile trading platform were up 1.7% in early trading Tuesday, even as other crypto-exposed stocks  Coinbase Global  and  Strategy  were down 4% and 6% respectively.  Bitcoin was down 0.4% to $77,564.
